Agent Client Protocol (ACP): Kiro Everywhere

Kiro's agents aren't locked to Kiro's own IDE.
ACP — Agent Client Protocol — lets Kiro's agents work across compatible tools.
You're not locked into one interface to use Kiro's agent power.
It's built for an ecosystem, not a walled garden.

Episode 69 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
